The '''Royal Library of Alderaan''' was the [[Library/Legends|library]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It contained secret information of the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].
